description: I recently completed a series of twelve murals inside a villa, each one designed in a completely different style and theme. The idea was to let every wall have its own personality—its own story to tell. Some walls reflect the elegance and mystery of Pharaonic art, while others capture the raw, grounded beauty of Bedouin culture. There are dreamlike fantasy pieces full of surreal elements, alongside murals that embrace the classic harmony of fine lines and balance. To contrast that, a few walls burst with funky energy, using bold colors and playful shapes, while others are painted with expressive, messy brushstrokes that bring out a more emotional and spontaneous side. Some are delicate and detailed, inviting the viewer to come closer and discover the intricate linework. Altogether, the murals create a journey through different moods, styles, and stories—an artistic exploration of heritage, imagination, and free expression, all living together under one roof.
title: FAKHR

🎨✨ Cactus Hostel Mural Project

The client was super friendly and easy to work with 🤝, which made the entire process smooth, relaxed, and inspiring. I loved bringing this piece to life, and I’m really happy with how it reflects the cozy, artistic spirit of the place 🎭💚.

description:
These murals are inspired by the rich traditions, colors, and spirit of the desert.
Each piece captures the simplicity and depth of Bedouin life — from flowing fabrics and desert landscapes to the warmth of gatherings around fire and tea. The lines are raw yet intentional, the colors earthy and vibrant, echoing the connection between people and land. These murals aren’t just decorative — they carry the quiet stories of resilience, freedom, and identity that live in Bedouin culture.

description: A mural that captures a moment of quiet wonder beneath the sea — Dolphin Girl shows a young girl swimming freely alongside a dolphin, their bodies moving in harmony as if dancing through the ocean's embrace. Surrounded by gentle waves, scattered light beams, and the calm rhythm of the deep, the girl’s expression is one of pure connection and peace. The dolphin, curious and kind, mirrors her presence with a sense of playful wisdom. Together, they represent a timeless dream — the unity between humans and nature, freedom without fear, and the magic that lives beneath the surface
title: Dolphin Girl
